The automated identification of unintended changes in system configurations from an approved baseline, used to prevent policy violations, security gaps, and compliance failures.

What is Detección de Deriva de Configuración?

In this glossary, Detección de Deriva de Configuración refers to: The automated identification of unintended changes in system configurations from an approved baseline, used to prevent policy violations, security gaps, and compliance failures.
